map.蛇头吃到食物则体长 +1、分数 +10；撞墙或撞到自身身体则结束。经典 20×2: When the snake head eats food its length grows by 1 and the score by 10; hitting a wall or its own body ends the game. The classic 20×20 grid is controlled with the arrow keys.…
